sequential_dependency.intermediate: Region-local true depth fields and ordered palettes, including background-colored early layers.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Partition nonwall regions, compute their eight-neighbor inward-erosion layers and recover palette colors at marked depths.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint each region by cycling or bouncing through its palette according to the derived depth at each cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Internal notches and wall turns change ring depth even at identical bounding-box coordinates. Replacing true region layers with bounding-box layers while retaining the same recovered palettes changes the final grid.
